related_questions.question: How long does it take to fix vitamin C deficiency?

text_blocks.snippet: For most vitamin C deficiencies, including scurvy, you can expect to see improvements in symptoms within a few days of treatment, with a full recovery often taking a few weeks to a few months. The timeline depends on the severity of the deficiency and the treatment method.
snippet_highlighted_words: expect to see improvements in symptoms within a few days of treatment, with a full recovery often taking a few weeks to a few months

list.title: Mild deficiencies:
list.snippet: Symptoms like fatigue and irritability may start to improve within 48 hours.

list.title: Scurvy (severe deficiency):
list.snippet: Symptoms like fatigue, lethargy, pain, anorexia, and confusion can improve within 24 hours of supplementation. Bruising, skin lesions, and gum bleeding may take a week or two to resolve. Complete recovery, including the resolution of corkscrew hairs, can take around 3 months.

list.title: Treatment:
list.snippet: Treatment usually involves vitamin C supplementation (either orally or intravenously, depending on severity). The initial treatment may involve high doses, followed by a maintenance dose. Dietary adjustments to increase vitamin C intake are also recommended.

text_blocks.snippet: It's important to consult with a healthcare professional for proper diagnosis and treatment of vitamin C deficiency, especially if you suspect scurvy.
